official_definition: Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any "The PartnerBug Gataru", you can summon this card from the Hand by paying costs from your Reserve, or paying costs from your count to your Trash such that your count won't be less than four.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [High Speed - Mystery] or [High Speed - Mystery: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [High Speed - Mystery]", "give [High Speed - Mystery]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
